items.q: That's a hard thing for a man like Butterfield. A fellow will say, that man can play anywhere.

ctx.x: Vega was a good trumpet player, any way you're looking. That's a hard thing for a man like Butterfield. A fellow will say, that man can play anywhere. What could Vega do? Vega could play trumpet.
